blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Risa Hontiveros on Friday welcomed the issuance of an extradition warrant of arrest against Kingdom of Jesus Christ (KOJC) leader Apollo Quiboloy, saying he could no longer evade accountability now. According to the senator, the said the development was good news for victims who have long been waiting for justice, urging authorities to move the extradition process forward without delay. “The world is listening. Hindi na makakatakas si Quiboloy sa pananagutan,” she said in a statement sent to reporters. (The world is listening. Quiboloy can no longer evade accountability.)
